output.reason: The linked PR [ev-c4924df5cd52] states the problem concretely: the memcached cache client's `Fetch` lost the request context inside `fetchKeysBatched`, so it kept fetching keys after the client cancelled. The fix checks `ctx.Done()` before sending work to `inputCh`, so batch fetch now stops when the context is cancelled. [ev-78772d0770ff] adds a `stopped` flag so already-closed channels are not closed twice, and updates the tests. Together with the changed files in pkg/storage/chunk/cache/memcached.go [ev-050599e0c6d9], this is enough to write the open aspects. Applicability: deployments that use memcached as a cache backend. Consequence: an internal bugfix that changes behaviour, needs no operator action and has no stated config change.
